test_title: PYST 53: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment.

Despite the difficulties, Sarah __started her business with great energy and hard work,__ and performed remarkably well in the industry.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **hit the ground running**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"hit the ground running"** means to start something with great enthusiasm and energy, achieving success quickly. (जोश और ऊर्जा के साथ तेज़ी से शुरुआत करना) • **Example: **When she started her new job, she hit the ground running and impressed everyone with her efficiency. • **Explanation of the sentence:** The phrase "hit the ground running" is appropriate here because Sarah started her business with great energy and hard work, resulting in remarkable success in the industry. (सही रूप से दर्शाता है कि सारा ने उत्साह के साथ शुरुआत की और सफलता हासिल की।) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: hit the hay** (सोने जाना) – This idiom means to go to bed or sleep. It does not fit the context of the sentence. • **Example: **After a long day at work, I decided to hit the hay early. • **Option 3: spilled the beans** (राज़ खोल देना) – This idiom means to reveal a secret or confidential information. It is irrelevant in the given context. • **Example: **She accidentally spilled the beans about the surprise party. • **Option 4: let sleeping dogs lie** (पुरानी बातों को न छेड़ना) – This idiom means to avoid interfering in a situation that is currently stable to prevent trouble. It does not apply to the sentence. • **Example: **Let’s not discuss that argument again; it’s best to let sleeping dogs lie. 2f:Td1e, The correct answer is: **Protocol**.
